goods.name: Sandstone
goods.use: Crushed into dirt (brick earth) at the Stone Crusher; rubble aggregate in concrete; sandstone masonry construction.

goods.name: Limestone
goods.use: Cement recipe; metallurgical flux for high-grade steel; limestone masonry construction.

goods.name: Brick
goods.use: Fired from dirt and water at the Cement Kiln; brick plinths, walls and chimneys of the buildings that show them (material cost rule); brick masonry blocks.

goods.name: Cement
goods.use: Concrete recipe; mortar for sandstone and brick masonry.

goods.name: Concrete
goods.use: Permanent quarries; advanced factory, civic, science and rocket foundations; levees; reinforced dam blocks; overflow dams; overhangs; scaffolds.

sources.name: Sandstone outcrop
sources.description: Finite surface deposit. A nearby Sandstone Pit removes stone; exhausted deposits disappear. Place these in the map editor before play.

sources.name: Limestone outcrop
sources.description: Finite surface deposit. A nearby Limestone Pit removes stone; exhausted deposits disappear. Place these in the map editor before play.

sources.name: Deep sandstone seam
sources.description: Permanent geological source. Build a Sandstone Quarry over this marked site; extraction requires water, workers and {quarryHp} hp.

sources.name: Deep limestone seam
sources.description: Permanent geological source. Build a Limestone Quarry over this marked site; extraction requires water, workers and {quarryHp} hp.

buildings.name: Sandstone pit
buildings.description: Workers collect finite sandstone deposits within walking range. Sandstone becomes brick earth at a Stone Crusher and concrete at a Concrete Mixer; later build a permanent Sandstone Quarry.

buildings.name: Limestone pit
buildings.description: Workers collect finite limestone deposits within walking range. Feed a Cement Kiln; later build a permanent Limestone Quarry.

buildings.name: Sandstone quarry
buildings.description: Extracts sandstone indefinitely from a marked deep seam. Requires water and {hp} hp. Build over a Deep Sandstone Seam.

buildings.name: Limestone quarry
buildings.description: Extracts limestone indefinitely from a marked deep seam. Requires water and {hp} hp. Build over a Deep Limestone Seam.

buildings.name: Stone crusher
buildings.description: Grinds 3 sandstone into 8 dirt (brick earth) per hour at {hp} hp. Supply the dirt to a Cement Kiln for bricks and cement.

buildings.name: Cement kiln
buildings.description: Moulds and fires 4 dirt and 1 water into 4 bricks, or 3 limestone and 1 dirt into 2 cement, every 2 hours, burning one log per batch and {hp} hp. No separate heat system.

buildings.name: Concrete mixer
buildings.description: Mixes 3 sandstone rubble, 2 cement and 4 water into 8 concrete every 2 hours at {hp} hp. Concrete unlocks permanent quarries and advanced construction.
